Job Title: Sales Assistant
Company: Endureed
Location: Lake City, FL / Remote eligible
Reports to: VP of Global Sales

The Sales Assistant is the operational backbone of the US sales team. You'll provide hands-on administrative, coordination, and customer support to the VP of Global Sales — keeping the department running smoothly, accurately, and on time across residential and Strategic Partner (SP) channels.
This isn't a role for someone who wants to wing it, work independently without structure, or stay at arm's length from the details. It's a role for someone who finds real satisfaction in making sure nothing falls through the cracks someone who takes pride in accuracy, follows through without being asked twice, and genuinely enjoys being the person others can count on.
If you're the kind of person who gets energized by creating order, supporting a team, and doing the unglamorous-but-critical work that makes everything else possible keep reading.
✓ You'll thrive here if you...

· Get genuine satisfaction from organizing, tracking, and keeping things accurate

· Take ownership of tasks and follow through without being reminded

· Prefer a defined role with clear expectations over open-ended autonomy

· Are naturally calm, steady, and don't rattle easily when things get busy

· Build trust by being dependable, not by being loud

· Take pride in serving others and helping your team look good

· Are bilingual in English and Spanish and comfortable using both professionally

· Thrive in a structured, process-driven environment with consistent routines
✗ This role is NOT for you if you...

· Need to be the center of attention or get credit to feel motivated

· Prefer creating your own process over following an established one

· Dislike repetitive tasks or detailed administrative work

· Get bored or frustrated when you're not driving strategy or making big decisions

· Struggle to stay organized when managing multiple people's priorities at once

· Want flexibility to define your own schedule or work style without check-ins

· Move fast and loose, accuracy and follow-through aren't your strong suits

· Are looking for a stepping stone to a sales rep role as fast as possible

· Provide administrative support to the VP of Global Sales, calendar management, scheduling, travel coordination, and communications

· Prepare and update sales reports, presentations, and customer-facing materials for residential and SP accounts

· Own CRM data entry, lead tracking, and pipeline management, data must be accurate and current at all times

· Coordinate between the sales team and the SP network, including onboarding new partners and managing ongoing communication

· Track SP territory coverage and ensure Basics product line distribution aligns with current SP network policies

· Conduct market and competitor research to support US sales strategy

· Help organize sales campaigns, trade shows, events, and client meetings, logistics, materials, follow-up

· Ensure timely document and information flow between the sales team, operations, and other departments

· Support order processing and client onboarding across residential and SP channels

· Bilingual — English and Spanish required, written and spoken (non-negotiable)

· 2+ years in a sales support, coordinator, or administrative role, you've done this before and you're good at it

· CRM experience required; NetSuite or similar ERP a strong plus

· Proficiency with Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace, especially Excel/Sheets and PowerPoint/Slides

· Exceptional organizational skills, you manage multiple moving pieces without losing track of any of them

· High attention to detail, errors bother you before anyone else catches them

· Calm, professional communication style, written and verbal

· Experience in building materials, construction, or a product-based industry is a plus, not a requirement

The Sales Associate is responsible for providing all Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) customers with world class customer service with an additional emphasis on courtesy.

Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an ¿I can do that¿ mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. Sales associates market and train self-checkout to shoppers.

Maintain self-checkout units to include cleaning the units input and output belts, scanner glass, terminal display, magnetic card reader heads, and shutting down and rebooting as needed. Replace consumable supplies as needed. Charge mobile devices and device batteries as needed.

Sales associates understand how to perform functions from each of the following Self-Checkout application states: Shopping Mode, Store Mode, Assist Mode, Supervisor Mode, and Training Mode. Successfully interpret lane status indicators and clear all events identified by lane signals and lane status indicators.

May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel. Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment.

Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned. This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance.
Minimum of 1-year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly. Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required.

About the Company At BenefitHub , our commitment is to offer employee perks and voluntary benefits that give real value to employees, focusing on enhancing the quality of their daily lives.

We continuously strive to add unique and exciting values to the offers available to our members, partnering with a diverse range of global brands to achieve this. Join our mission to improve the daily life of millions by providing access to the world’s largest selection of personally relevant benefits. By contributing to our goal of becoming the most widely used benefits platform, you will be enhancing the lives of millions of people around the globe.

HubSpot) Represent the company at association industry conferences and trade shows (e.g., ASAE, association management events) Consistently meet or exceed monthly, quarterly and annual sales quotas About Mainspring Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power.

The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.

The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together: Pragmatic Optimism Excellence without Ego Proactive Collaboration Job Overview As a Data Center Senior Sales Associate, every day will bring new opportunities to help our customers succeed.

On a daily basis, you'll dive into connecting with potential clients, nurturing initial stage pipeline and will work side by side with a team of Account Executives helping drive opportunities to close. What makes this job unique is the chance to be a part of a culture that celebrates success and learns from every challenge.

Our team is collaborative and supportive, providing you with the resources to reach your full potential. You'll be making an impact not just on our company's growth, but also on the success of our customers' businesses.

At the end of each day, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your efforts are directly contributing to the vibrant energy and success of our dynamic company.

Responsibilities Perform research on data center accounts including mapping corporate structure, identifying key decision-makers and influencers, understanding business drivers, recent initiatives, and financials Develop key relationships within engaged target accounts, conducting and facilitating conversations that will lead to new or additional opportunities within an account Act as the subject matter expert on the deal team for developing project economics and interfacing with the customer's finance and sustainability evaluators Manage the opportunity funnel with the Account Executives (AE's), ensuring deals are progressing and updated in Salesforce.com Gather and perform economic analysis aligned with customer development plans Prepare and give presentations to prospective customers Work with the prospects and the account executives to maintain mutual plans ensuring key milestones are on target Work cross-functionally with supporting teams to package solutions for customers based on Mainspring’s value props Qualifications Experience: 3+ years of sales experience, with a strong track record of meeting or exceeding quotas.

Experience within the data center, telecom, or energy industries is highly preferred Sales & Pipeline Management: Proven ability to qualify prospects, navigate the sales cycle, and run effective negotiations.

Strong pipeline discipline with a history of consistent CRM hygiene (Salesforce preferred) Communication & Presence: Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills with a natural ability to build rapport and manage multi-stakeholder relationships Analytical Aptitude: Ability to analyze sales data, evaluate basic financial models, and adapt to evolving market trends Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field Does your experience not meet all of our posted requirements?

Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to positions unless they meet every listed requirement.

At Mainspring, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, flexible, and collaborative environment, so if you want to help us transition the world to clean and affordable electricity, and don’t meet all posted requirements for a particular role, we’d still love to hear from you.

Mainspring can sometimes be flexible enough to shift responsibilities for the right person, or otherwise identify open or upcoming roles that may better fit your professional background. In more traditional words, Mainspring Energy , Inc is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

This compensation and benefits information is based on Mainspring Energy 's estimate as of the date of publication and may be modified in the future. We generally do not negotiate on salary once we have made an offer.

The level of pay within the range will depend on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant prior experience and/or education, or particular skills and expertise.

New hires joining the company tend to be paid within the starting base pay range noted above, with opportunities to increase pay over time based on development of additional skills, competencies, and company-specific knowledge. Originally posted on Himalayas

They integrate deep market research, creative brand positioning, and demand generation with high-performance SDR teams to build sustainable sales pipelines for scaling B2B businesses. The team prides itself on an intelligence-first methodology, ensuring every campaign is backed by data and high-confidence market insights. Serving innovative founders in the SaaS, FinTech, and professional services sectors, they have a proven track record of generating millions in pipeline value.

This is a collaborative, high-growth environment suited for professionals who value transparency, original research, and the pursuit of meaningful, high-quality sales outcomes over volume-based metrics.

We specialize in turning deep market intelligence into real-world results—meaning you will be booking high-value meetings with pre-warmed prospects who are ready to talk business. 👉 In unserem Unternehmen schätzen wir Vielfalt und fördern sie aktiv – wir sind überzeugt, dass unterschiedliche Perspektiven und Hintergründe uns stärker machen. Wir legen den Fokus auf Potenzial statt auf einen „perfekten“ Lebenslauf.

Wenn dich diese Rolle begeistert und du glaubst, dass du in ihr wachsen kannst – auch wenn du nicht jede einzelne Anforderung erfüllst – freuen wir uns sehr, von dir zu hören! LOCATION 🌐 Unser Büros befinden sich in Berlin & Dresden. Dank unseres flexiblen Hybridmodells (auch 100% remote möglich) kannst du dort arbeiten, wo du am produktivsten bist.

Darauf kannst du dich bei Shopfully freuen 🤗 🌎 Eine spannende Möglichkeit, in einem internationalen, schnell wachsenden Unternehmen mitzuwirken 🕶️ Ein offenes, lebendiges und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld 🧠 Viel Raum für Eigenverantwortung, Flexibilität und die Vorteile eines hybriden Arbeitsmodells 📚 Kontinuierliche Entwicklung durch Lernangebote und regelmäßiges Feedback 🍓 Ein modernes, zentral gelegenes Büro mit frischen Snacks, Kaffee und ergonomischer Ausstattung 🎉 Gemeinsame Erlebnisse, die verbinden: Offsites, After-Work-Drinks, Firmenfeiern und Teamevents 💻 Die passende Ausstattung, damit du überall produktiv arbeiten und dir deinen Arbeitsplatz optimal einrichten kannst 🧰 Zusätzliche standortspezifische Benefits entsprechend deinem lokalen Vertrag (Empfehlungsprogramm, Shopping-Rabatte etc.) WHO WE ARE 💜 We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities.

We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us. TO FEEL AT HOME 🛋️ I N SHOPFULLY YOU NEED 🎯

At ABC Fitness , we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.
ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION:
ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at abcfitness.com.
About ABC Fitness
ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.
From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together.
Learn more at abcfitness.com

Compensation and benefits may vary by location and are subject to applicable legal, business, and market requirements. WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated people? And are you curious or passionate about sales?

SetSales is Northern Europe’s leading sales community and aims to connect and develop commercially-minded executives, decision makers in sales, and aspiring entrepreneurs. We are connecting more than 4,000 professionals from more than 15 countries every year.
SetSales is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc.

You will play a key role in helping us build some of the world's leading business conferences by bringing the right people into the room.
We will give you the training, tools and responsibility to succeed while continuously challenging you to develop your commercial skills and accelerate your career.
You’ll be based out of our HQ in London, where you will work alongside an ambitious and entrepreneurial team.
Uncapped earning potential: A competitive base salary and attractive commission structure where your results directly impact your earnings.
Rapid development: An opportunity to build exceptional sales skills in a high-performance environment with continuous coaching and feedback.
International exposure: Speak every day with senior executives, investors and business leaders from companies around the world.
International travel: The opportunity to attend our conferences and see first-hand the events and communities you help build.
Unlimited growth potential: We strongly believe in promoting internally and have a track record of giving exceptional performers significant responsibility early in their careers.

Your mission will be to drive revenue by selling delegate passes to senior professionals attending United Media's international conferences.
Your responsibilities will vary; however, some of them will be to:
Drive new business revenue: Proactively reach out to prospective delegates and convert them into paying attendees across our portfolio of conferences.
Own your sales targets: Take responsibility for ambitious monthly revenue targets and consistently work towards exceeding them.
Execute high-volume outreach: Work within a fast-paced outbound sales environment, making 60+ calls per day and creating approximately 10 qualified sales opportunities or proposals.
Own your pipeline: Manage prospects from first conversation through follow-up, proposal and close, ensuring opportunities continue to move forward.
Become an expert: Develop a strong understanding of our conferences, audiences and industries so you can confidently communicate why the right people should be in the room.
Collaborate across teams: Work closely with our marketing, content and conference teams to continuously improve our campaigns and the experience we offer delegates.
What we expect from you
You have a strong work ethic, a high sense of urgency and a genuine desire to succeed. You enjoy competing against ambitious targets, take ownership of your results and are motivated by seeing your own performance improve.
Most importantly, you want to sell . You enjoy the chase, the conversation and the feeling of turning an opportunity into a closed deal.
Drive & ambition: You are highly motivated, competitive and want to be exceptional at what you do.
Commercial mindset: You are excited by targets, revenue and the opportunity to directly influence your earnings through your performance.
Resilience: You are comfortable with a high level of outbound activity and have the persistence to keep going when you hear "no".
Communication: You are confident speaking with new people and can communicate professionally and persuasively over the phone and in writing.
Relationship building: You are genuinely curious about people and able to build rapport quickly with senior professionals.
Organisation: You can prioritise effectively and stay on top of a large number of prospects, conversations and follow-ups.
Growth mindset: You actively seek feedback and continuously look for ways to improve your performance.
Winning mentality: Whether demonstrated through sales, academics, competitive sports, entrepreneurship or another environment, you have evidence of setting ambitious goals and pushing yourself to achieve them.
Previous sales experience is an advantage but not a requirement . We are equally interested in exceptional graduates and early-career candidates who can demonstrate the drive, communication skills and competitive mindset needed to build a successful career in sales.
Start date: Flexible.
Monday–Friday we work from our office next to Sloane Square Station. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, we do not offer remote work.

About Grubhub
At Grubhub, we believe food is more than just a meal: It’s a source of discovery, connection, and pure enjoyment. There’s a time and place for every type of dish, from hidden neighborhood gems to tried-and-true favorites, and we exist to connect people with the food they love in all the ways they like to dig in. We’ve been at it since 2004, but now, as part of Wonder , Grubhub is operating with a renewed sense of momentum and the high-velocity energy of a powerhouse startup.
As a leading U.S. ordering and delivery marketplace, we feature over 415,000 merchants in more than 4,000 cities, creating the ultimate food experience by elevating online ordering through innovative restaurant technology, easy-to-use platforms, and an improved delivery experience.

We are constantly finding new ways to innovate—from integrated grocery delivery with groceries powered by Instacart to exclusive loyalty programs. Join our team, based out of New York City, Chicago and Denver, and help us give our diners the exceptional value they deserve.
About The Opportunity
The Grubhub Sales Executive role is a great opportunity to leverage your sales skills to make an impact on the company’s rapid growth. Plus, you’ll be selling restaurant owners exactly what they already want: more business. Our current Sales Executive’s love the team events, contests, and of course the meal perks. This is the place to hone your sales skills, and make great money doing it.
You’ll be on the front lines of building Grubhub’s national restaurant partner network. You’ll research and consult with restaurants, contact and meet with decision makers, and show them how Grubhub can benefit their business. You’ll need to be resourceful, persuasive, determined, competitive, and have the ability to easily connect with people from all walks of life.
The Impact You Will Make
Discover Grubhub’s next wave of great local restaurants: We need you to engage the most wanted restaurants in your territory and help us discover those hidden gems our diners are craving.
Be the market expert: gather restaurant feedback, monitor competitor activity, marketing opportunities, and provide recommendations for improvement to management.
Consult with restaurant owners on the benefits of joining GrubHub and having access to our rapidly growing community of hungry diners. Identify needs and goals of the restaurant and demonstrate how Grubhub can help grow their business.
Conduct extensive cold calling (60+ dials per day), emailing, and social outreach to prospective decision makers.
Manage a territory and own the entire sales pipeline from prospecting to closing.
Secure appointments with prospective clients to uncover needs and present the value of a partnership.
Travel into the market to conduct in person sales pitches with merchant owners.
Exceed high-volume sales goals while working within a team environment.

Als B2B Sales Development Representative spielst du eine zentrale Rolle im Wachstum von FINN. Du gewinnst neue Geschäftskunden, generierst hochwertige Leads und übergibst diese an unsere erfahrenen Account Executives. Dabei verstehst du die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und Kundinnen, begeisterst sie für das Thema AutoAbo und kannst dein Know-how voll einbringen.
Die Rolle bietet dir die ideale Chance, deine Karriere im Sales aktiv zu gestalten und Führungsverantwortung zu übernehmen. Du sammelst nicht nur wertvolle Vertriebserfahrungen, sondern trägst maßgeblich zur Entwicklung und Unterstützung unseres Teams bei. In unserem dynamischen Umfeld kannst du dein Vertriebstalent voll entfalten und deine berufliche Zukunft aktiv vorantreiben.

Lead Generierung: Du bist maßgeblich verantwortlich für das Gewinnen neuer, hochwertiger Leads und das Wachstum von FINN, indem du potentielle Kunden durch Kaltakquise ansprichst und für FINN begeisterst. Anschließend stellst du eine reibungslose Übergabe an unsere B2B Account Executives sicher.
Prospecting: Du unterstützt unser Team beim Research und Prospecting von relevanten Branchen und Firmen mit dem Anspruch, die perfekte Zielgruppe anzusprechen. Dabei entwickelst du passende Strategien für eine effektive Ansprache.
Entwickle deine Markt- und Produktkenntnis weiter: Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für unser Angebot, wodurch du flexibel und professionell auf Anliegen potenzieller Geschäftskunden reagieren kannst.
Sammle Kundenanforderungen: Durch deinen kontinuierlichen Austausch mit potentiellen Kunden verstehst du deren Bedürfnisse. Mit der Sammlung, Validierung und Weitergabe der Anforderungen an unser Management trägst du erheblich dazu bei, neue Chancen für existierende und neue Kundengruppen zu entdecken und unser Angebot weiterzuentwickeln.
Leadership: Übernimm die Führung und Entwicklung unserer Sales Interns. Unterstütze sie dabei, alle notwendigen Fähigkeiten und Kenntnisse für den Vertriebserfolg zu erwerben, und begleite das Team auf dem Weg zur Erreichung seiner Verkaufsziele.
Your Profile

Ausbildung & Track Record: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. BWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften), kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit nachgewiesener Erfolgsbilanz im B2B-Outbound-Sales und Cold Calling .
Kommunikation & Überzeugungskraft: Exzellente sprachliche und schriftliche Argumentationsfähigkeit, hohe Resilienz sowie Durchsetzungsvermögen in einem dynamischen Hyper-Growth-Umfeld .
Eigenverantwortung & Zielerreichung: Ausgeprägte Selbstorganisation, lösungsorientiertes Handeln und eine datengetriebene Arbeitsweise zur kontinuierlichen Überfüllung deiner Sales-Quoten .
Sprachkenntnisse: Exzellente/Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau) sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift .

Leadership & Coaching Experience: Erste praktische Erfahrung im Mentoring, Peer-Coaching oder der fachlichen Führung von Sales Interns bzw. Junior SDRs .
Sales Tech Stack: Versierter Umgang mit modernen CRM- und Sales-Prozess-Tools (wie HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach oder Salesloft) .

Shared Success (VSOP Finanzbeteiligung): Wir gewinnen gemeinsam. Über unser Virtual Stock Option Program profitierst du direkt vom langfristigen Wertwachstum und dem Erfolg von FINN.
Fuel your Growth (1.500€ Weiterbildungsbudget): Stillstand ist keine Option. Mit deinem jährlichen Development-Budget in Höhe von 1.500€ für Fortbildungen und Seminare entscheidest du selbst, wie du dich persönlich und professionell weiterentwickelst.
Family First (Kita-Zuschuss & Flexibilität): Wir unterstützen dich und deine Familie. Profitiere von einem monatlichen Zuschuss zur Kinderbetreuung , exklusiven Zugängen zu Kita-Plätzen in München sowie maximaler Flexibilität, um Berufs- und Familienleben stressfrei zu vereinbaren.
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV): Wir denken an deine Zukunft. FINN bezuschusst deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit einem starken Arbeitgeberanteil von 66 % .
Experience our Product (25% Auto-Abo Rabatt): Werde selbst zum FINN-Driver! Du erhältst einen satten Mitarbeiterrabatt von 25% auf dein Auto-Abo oder nutzt alternativ unser attraktives Fahrrad-Leasing (Bike-Leasing) .
Health & Mindset (Sport & Gesundheit): Deine Energie ist unser Antrieb. Profitiere von einer subventionierten EGYM Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft für Fitness und Sport sowie professionellem Mental Health Support.
Munich Office Life: Barista-Kaffee auf Knopfdruck, Matcha und der legendäre Obstkorb erwarten dich in unserem modernen Headquarter in München . On top gibt es einen täglichen Lunch - Zuschuss für dein Mittagessen .
Team Spirit & Corporate Events: Wir sind mehr als nur Kolleg:innen. Ob Sommer-Events am See oder einfach ein entspannter After-Work-Drink. Wir feiern unsere Meilensteine bei regelmäßigen Teamevents gemeinsam.

FINN ist Deutschlands führende Auto-Abo-Plattform und eines der wenigen deutschen Unicorns im Mobility-Sektor. Mit über 400 Kolleg:innen aus mehr als 40 Nationen bauen wir an der Zukunft der Mobilität und machen den Zugang zum eigenen Auto so unkompliziert wie nie zuvor.

Was uns dabei wirklich stolz macht, sind aber nicht nur die Zahlen, sondern das, was dahintersteckt: unser starker Team-Drive, der Wille, den Status quo zu challengen, und die Ambition, wirklich etwas zu bewegen.

Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Scale-ups in Deutschland direkt Verantwortung zu übernehmen und unsere Success Story aktiv mitzugestalten. Wir fangen gerade erst an!
Weitere Informationen: www.finn.com

Wir stehen allen Personengruppen offen, unabhängig von Alter, Hautfarbe, Herkunft, Ethnizität, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität und/oder -ausdruck, Familienstand oder anderen gesetzlich geschützten Merkmalen.

Scope automates the data collection that’s slowing down the physical world.
We’re building the best AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers on the front line of inspection. Along the way, we’re building the world’s largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.
It’s a $2T market and we’re just getting started. We have grown revenue 1 0x in the last year and on track to reach 10M ARR in 2026 . Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX .
We’ve assembled a best-in-class team : people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Goldman Sachs, Flexport and Amazon.
Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures , the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with over 100 unicorns backed to date.
We are looking for an ENT Sales Executive who is entrepreneurial and a commercial powerhouse ready to lead our revenue growth from the front lines.
You’ve already proven you can sell somewhere else and you’ve hit or beaten quota, and you know how to run a deal end to end. Now you want more than the next quota. You want to build the system, not just work inside one someone else built. This is a role for someone who wants to take the next step in their career who’s hungry to own pre-sales and post-sales, not just the close.
If you’re energised by high velocity, deep customer relationships, and the chance to build something from nothing in a massive legacy market, this will be a career-defining role.

Own the full sales lifecycle : Manage the entire funnel from initial discovery and platform deep-dives to commercial negotiation and closing five- and six-figure ARR deals.
Build what happens after the deal closes : Set up onboarding and customer success frameworks from scratch, so early customers get value fast and become references for the next deal.
Master the TIC domain : Become an absolute expert on our product and the workflows of our customers (lab managers, compliance directors, and operations executives). You won’t rely on a carousel of sales engineers, you will be the trusted advisor.
Navigate high stakes £100k+ ARR cycles : Lead complex, multi-month enterprise sales cycles with global TIC organisations, confidently navigating multi stakeholder buying committees, rigorous governance/security reviews, and legal bottlenecks to close seven figure, transformational deals.
Shape the GTM playbook : Work closely with our Founders, Product, and Marketing teams to test new messaging, refine our outbound strategies, and relay direct market feedback to help steer the product roadmap.
Wear multiple hats : In an early-stage startup, "that's not my job" doesn't exist. You’ll occasionally step up to support onboarding, attend industry events, or jump into whatever the week needs.

We don’t care about a perfect, check-box resume. We care about hunger, sales instinct, and the drive to build something that doesn’t exist yet. You’ll be a fantastic fit if:
You’ve already proven you can sell: 3–6 years of experience in a fast-paced B2B software sales or comparable commercial role (e.g. enterprise SaaS, top-tier consulting, or tech-forward industrial sales), with a track record of beating quota.
You’ve outgrown your current setup: You’ve hit a ceiling and there is too much structure, not enough ownership, a playbook you didn’t write and can’t change and you’re ready to build one from scratch instead.
You love the weeds and the big picture: You can zoom in to understand a granular, technical workflow for a testing lab, and zoom out to negotiate a strategic contract with an executive.
You are comfortable with ambiguity: We have product-market fit, but we are still building the machine. You don't need a fully-baked playbook; you are excited to build it as you go.

Our benefits are designed to reflect our values. We offer comprehensive employee benefits, which includes the following:
Highly competitive base and significant equity so you have a stake in what you are building
We provide full visa sponsorship that has allowed us to have unrestricted access to global talent and build an international, diverse team
Tools to do your job including brand new MacBook laptop + Scope merch
Generous above-market annual leave allowance
Full Medical, Dental coverage with Bupa
Employee Pension through NEST
Flexible Parental Leave (including Adoption Leave)
Healthy meal prep delivered Lunch and Dinners as well as fully stocked fridge and snacks, drinks
Team lunches on Fridays
Regular events including off-sites
Learning and Development: Access to online resources and courses as well as internal Lunch and Learn seminars that allow collaboration and continuous development
At Scope, we believe diverse perspectives build stronger products and teams. Even if your background doesn't perfectly align with every single bullet point here, if you have the drive and the commercial instincts to excel in this role and be a part of a transformational start up, we strongly encourage you to apply.

Eventbrite is disrupting a huge industry in desperate need of a shakeup. We're looking for a talented, driven and collaborative Business development manager to be the first point of contact for our sales efforts, generating demand and building a pipeline for our Account executives.

s.h: A few examples of your responsibilities
s.t:
Support the B2B Sales Function. Joining a fast-moving team and helping us scale a world-class sales organization to its next level, you'll focus on executing and optimizing our sales processes, managing client relationships, and dricing measureable results in enterprise sales.
Go after high-potential leads. Identify and cold-call on-target businesses to build a portfolio of respected, revenue-driving corporate clients.
Learn the industry inside and out. Understand the incentives, pressure points, and decision-makers of your industry so you can build profitable relationships.
Work closely with the product. Speak about it with clarity and confidence. Gather feedback from clients and share input to help shape future development.
Follow the data. Keep a close eye on performance metrics to gauge impact and zero in on the highest-value opportunities.
Stand out at every touchpoint. Deliver outstanding service that builds trust with every client interaction.
What we look for
Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

An exceptional opportunity for growth . We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. If you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects.
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
Competitive pay. Typically, we offer individuals with limited experience a base salary of $70,173 to $91,661 in the US, with an additional performance-based variable compensation component. Compensation varies by location and expected impact, and grows rapidly as you gain experience and translate it into greater contributions. For individuals who demonstrate exceptional capability, we may offer compensation that extends beyond the usual ranges to reflect their higher expected impact.
Commitment & contract
Permanent. Full-time.
Location
Fully remote.
The selection process
If you pass our screening, we’ll invite you to a couple of interviews, designed to assess your motivation, ambitions, and how you approach unfamiliar problems. Interviews are a two-way conversation: a chance for us to get to know you, and for you to learn more about the company. So make the most of it—ask questions, dig into the way we work, and hear directly from the people you’re going to meet.
We set the bar high and won't extend an offer until we're convinced we've found the right candidate. This is why a job may stay open for months or be reposted several times.
Studies suggest that women tend not to apply for a job if their CV isn’t a perfect fit. Here, talent takes precedence over experience. So if you like the role and think you could be awesome at it in time, go ahead and apply.

s.h: FIXING THE PLANET BY MAKING HOMES CARBON-FREE!
s.t:
Enter ist die Antwort auf eine Frage, die sich gerade Millionen Hausbesitzer stellen: nicht ob ihr Haus elektrifiziert wird, sondern wie und mit wem.
Als Deutschlands führender Energieberater begleiten wir energetische Sanierungen ganzheitlich — von der ersten Frage bis zur installierten Wärmepumpe oder PV-Anlage. 2025 haben wir dieses Wissen konsequent in den Vertrieb gebracht: jedes Haus ein Einzelfall, jede Lösung passgenau. Mit über 40 Millionen Euro Funding und 80 Mitarbeitenden wachsen wir in einem Markt, der gerade erst so richtig losgeht.
Unser Vertriebsinnendienst ist in den letzten zwei Jahren von einer Handvoll Leuten zu einem festen Team gewachsen. Die Zahlen stimmen. Was fehlt, ist jemand, der das Team führt, entwickelt und aus einer eingespielten Truppe ein System macht, das auch das nächste Wachstum trägt.
Unser Angebot
85.000 € Zielgehalt, davon 55.000 € Grundgehalt. Dein variabler Anteil hängt an der Leistung Deines Teams, nicht an Deiner eigenen Anwahlliste
Ein Team, das steht: keine Wackelkandidaten, keine Sanierungsaufgabe. Du übernimmst Leute, die liefern, und holst mehr raus
Direkter Draht zum Head of Sales, kurze Wege, echte Entscheidungsspielräume. Die Prozesse für Dein Team baust Du selbst
Wir stellen weiter ein. Dein Team wächst, während Du es führst
Zwei Tage Homeoffice, drei Tage Büro in Kreuzberg — Coaching am Hörer funktioniert nur live
Dein Spielfeld
Du führst das Pre-Sales-Team fachlich und disziplinarisch: Coaching am Hörer, Call-Reviews, 1:1s, Entwicklungspläne
Du steuerst über Zahlen — Speed to Lead, Anwahlfrequenz, Booking-Rate, Show-Rate, Conversion in Abschlüsse. Und Du erkennst, ob hinter einer Zahl ein Prozess klemmt oder jemand im Team Unterstützung braucht
Du baust die Grundlagen: Gesprächsleitfäden, Einwandbehandlung, Onboarding für neue Leute, Dokumentation, die auch funktioniert, wenn Du im Urlaub bist
Du gestaltest die Verschiebung unseres Provisionsmodells von Volumen zu Qualität mit. Wir sind von 70/30 auf 50/50 gegangen und wollen auf 30/70. Gleiche Frequenz, härterer Qualitätsanspruch: Ein Termin zählt für Dein Team erst richtig, wenn daraus ein Abschluss wird
Du pitchst selbst. Nicht jeden Tag, aber oft genug, dass Dein Team weiß, dass Du es kannst
So passt du in's Team
Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre ein Vertriebsteam von sechs oder mehr Leuten geführt — Inside Sales, SDR, Terminierung, Telefonvertrieb. Die erste Führungsrolle ist diese hier nicht
Du kommst selbst aus dem Vertrieb und hast Zahlen verantwortet, bevor Du sie von anderen eingefordert hast
Du arbeitest mit Daten statt mit Bauchgefühl: Du kannst benennen, welche Kennzahl Du in Deinem letzten Team bewegt hast, um wie viel, und was Du dafür konkret geändert hast
Du schreibst Dinge auf. Prozesse, Entscheidungen, Leitfäden — nicht weil es jemand verlangt, sondern weil Du weißt, was sonst passiert
Du führst über Verbindlichkeit, nicht über Lautstärke. Und Du kannst beides: Ansprüche stellen und Leute dort abholen, wo sie stehen

Spreeblick statt Hinterhof: unser Büro liegt direkt am Wasser, mitten in Kreuzberg
Zwei Remote-Tage pro Woche, der Rest live mit dem Team
Ein Learning-Budget, das auf Deine Entwicklung einzahlt – fachlich oder querbeet
Urban Sports Club, Jobticket, Kita-Zuschuss – je nachdem, was in Deinem Leben gerade zählt
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
Du begleitest Menschen dabei, ihre Häuser nachhaltiger zu machen – Energiewende zum Anfassen

You build your own view of the market, test what works, and feed what you learn directly back into how we sell. If you think in terms of pipeline health rather than call counts, and want real input into the commercial strategy of an early-stage company, this is that seat.
For this particular position we are looking for someone who can work from our Berlin office in a hybrid setup.

Build and own your outbound strategy for the healthcare segment, from account research through to a qualified meeting
Run a sustained, high-intensity outreach cadence across calls, email and LinkedIn, supported daily by AI tooling that handles the groundwork so your time goes into judgement, not admin
Qualify opportunities against clear criteria and hand off meetings that are genuinely ready for our Account Executives
Keep a clean, accurate record of every conversation and outcome in our CRM, your data shapes decisions beyond your own pipeline
Feed customer and market signal directly into our GTM strategy , your read on the market changes how we approach it, not just how you execute it
Track industry shifts and translate them into sharper positioning over time

En tant que consultant Oracle, vous aurez l'opportunité de devenir un expert et d'atteindre votre plein potentiel dans cette technologie. Être consultant peut parfois être perçu comme un travail solitaire, mais cela ne pourrait être plus éloigné de la réalité chez dbi services.

Chaque jour, nos experts interagissent et s'organisent entre eux lorsqu'ils consultent nos clients. Notre fort esprit d'équipe fait partie intégrante de notre culture chez dbi services.

Bien que nous valorisions la communauté Oracle et en soyons des membres très actifs, nous devons la majeure partie de notre succès au développement professionnel continu et au partage des connaissances.

C'est pourquoi nous encourageons nos employés à obtenir des certifications et à partager leurs connaissances à travers des formations clients, ainsi qu'à réaliser du coaching, fournir des informations à nos clients, faire des présentations lors d'événements et même rédiger des articles de blog
Découvrez tout ce que ce poste passionnant a à offrir pour développer votre plein potentiel avec les technologies Oracle.
À quoi s'attendre
Vous serez le principal point de contact pour nos clients et réaliserez leurs projets de manière responsable et autonome. Les tâches et missions qui vous attendent sont :
* Déploiement et installation de nouvelles infrastructures de bases de données Oracle
* Installation, maintenance, administration et patching des systèmes Oracle appliance bare metal avec technologie de virtualisation
* Migration de bases de données sur site et dans le cloud
* Patchage et mise à jour des bases de données Utilisation d'Ansible pour des patchings à grande échelle
* Déploiement et configuration de bases de données à haute disponibilité (Data Guard pour la version EE, dbvisit pour la version SE, RAC, etc.)
* Proposition de nouvelles solutions pour répondre aux exigences des clients (Snapshots, base de données conteneur, etc.)
* Mise en œuvre, configuration et gestion des sauvegardes de bases de données
* Récupération de bases de données suite à un incident
* Réplication et déplacement de données utilisant diverses technologies (duplication RMAN, export/import Data Pump, etc.)
* Réplication, filtrage et transformation de données avec Oracle GoldenGate
* Résolution des problèmes de performance des bases de données (étude et analyse des performances des bases de données)
* Administration et dépannage des bases de données Oracle (support utilisateur)
* Audit de licences
* Scripting Shell ainsi que création de scripts SQL et PL/SQL
* Préparation de la documentation technique pour les projets et solutions que vous fournissez
Ce que vous apportez
Si vous détenez un diplôme HES \[Haute école spécialisée suisse\], EPF \[École polytechnique fédérale suisse\] ou un diplôme équivalent, voici pourquoi vous seriez le candidat idéal pour nous :
* Vous avez une expérience confirmée avec le serveur de bases de données Oracle
* Vous avez une excellente connaissance et une solide expérience des sauvegardes et restaurations Oracle RMAN
* L'optimisation Oracle fait partie de vos compétences
* Vous avez des connaissances en haute disponibilité avec Dataguard ou Real Application Cluster
* Vous êtes un bon joueur d'équipe
* Vous parlez couramment le français et/ou l'allemand et maîtrisez l'anglais
* Vous pouvez apporter des connaissances sur Apex et PL/SQL
Pourquoi nous sommes un employeur de choix
Nous offrons
Développement professionnel continu
Nous proposons des formations et un développement continu tout au long de votre carrière chez dbi services.
Ouverture d'esprit
L'ouverture d'esprit est essentielle dans tout ce que nous faisons, et cela se manifeste par le respect mutuel et l'égalité sous tous les aspects.
La santé de nos employés
En plus des activités sportives organisées en interne, nous offrons un soutien financier pour les abonnements sportifs.
Modèles de travail responsables
Conditions de travail flexibles, télétravail, temps partiel et jusqu'à 10 jours de congé sans solde (en plus de 5 semaines de congés payés).
Valeurs fortes
Le partage d'expertise, le soutien mutuel et le développement des compétences sont au cœur de notre stratégie chez dbi services.
Culture d'entreprise
Nous voyons toujours les choses sous un angle bienveillant et aimable.
Envie de rejoindre notre équipe ?
Envoyez votre candidature (CV, certificats et diplômes) dans un seul fichier PDF à career@dbi-services.com
Que se passe-t-il ensuite ?
Une fois votre candidature reçue, vous recevrez une confirmation de notre part. Il faudra ensuite 14 jours avant que vous receviez une première réponse de notre service des ressources humaines. Si vous êtes sélectionné pour ce poste, vous serez invité à un premier entretien. La décision finale sera prise après le second entretien.
Des questions ?
Si vous avez des questions, notre responsable RH Magali Blenner se fera un plaisir de vous aider au +41 32 422 96 00.
Vous vous voyez dans ce rôle ?
En savoir plus !
En tant que consultant Oracle, vous consacrerez la majeure partie de votre temps à des missions de conseil et occasionnellement à des projets internes. Comme tous nos consultants, vous bénéficierez d'environ 20 jours par an de développement professionnel continu.

Vous aurez également l'opportunité de former nos clients et d'assister à des conférences techniques. Rattaché à l'équipe Oracle de plus de 15 personnes, vous serez sous la supervision de son Delivery Manager. Le Technology Leader et les collègues de votre équipe sont disponibles chaque jour pour vous soutenir si besoin.

Dans ce rôle, la coopération est essentielle, tout comme l'échange d'idées, la demande d'aide et l'entraide entre collègues par le partage des connaissances. \#BeSharing est notre valeur fondamentale, car l'union fait la force.

The SDR, Strategic Accounts is responsible for generating new business opportunities across both prospective and existing customer accounts. The role focuses on strategic account development, identifying high-value opportunities within complex organizations and creating meaningful engagement with the right stakeholders.
For prospective accounts , the SDR owns outbound prospecting efforts to identify and create new opportunities within high-priority strategic accounts. This includes researching accounts, identifying key stakeholders and buying groups, leveraging intent and account signals, and developing personalized outreach that creates meaningful sales conversations.
For customer accounts , the focus shifts toward expansion . The SDR partners closely with Account Directors and other customer-facing teams to identify whitespace, new teams or business units, additional use cases, and other signals that may indicate an opportunity for growth. The SDR helps create new relationships within existing customers and generates qualified expansion opportunities for the account team.
Across both motions, the SDR is expected to take an account-based approach rather than simply prospecting individual contacts. This means understanding the broader organization, mapping relevant stakeholders, identifying business priorities and potential use cases, and coordinating outreach across multiple personas where appropriate.
The role also supports strategic account planning by surfacing relevant insights, engagement signals, and prospect intelligence that can help Account Directors prioritize where to focus their efforts.

Generate qualified meetings and opportunities that align with the strategic account's potential and business priorities.
Maintain accurate account and contact intelligence in Salesforce and relevant sales development tools.

Younergy Solar ist ein Unternehmen für erneuerbare Energien, das Photovoltaik\- und Energielösungen für Unternehmen, öffentliche Institutionen und Privatkunden in der ganzen Schweiz entwickelt und realisiert. Zur Verstärkung unseres Wachstums in der Deutschschweiz suchen wir eine erfahrene Vertriebspersönlichkeit mit nachweisbarem Leistungsausweis im B2B\-Verkauf. Bei Younergy Solar akquirierst und berätst Du in erster Linie Unternehmen, Industriebetriebe, Landwirtschaftsbetriebe, Gemeinden und Immobilienverwaltungen in der Deutschschweiz – ergänzt durch punktuelle Privatkundenprojekte.

\- Du vertrittst Younergy an Messen, Ausstellungen und Fachveranstaltungen in der Deutschschweiz

Wir suchen eine erfahrene Vertriebspersönlichkeit mit nachweisbarem Erfolgsausweis und Netzwerk, kein Berufseinstieg.

\- Regelmässige Reisebereitschaft in die Deutschschweiz
